text: It's too bad she won't live. But then again, who does?
author: Gaff
visual_brief: An astronomical tracking diagram showing the hyperbolic trajectory of a lone interstellar object swinging once around a central star and departing into deep space, rendered in a precise engineering style with orbital ellipses, coordinate grids, and fine vector arrows indicating escape velocity.
alt: Astronomical schematic showing an interstellar object curving around a star
